approval.note: Drafted by the implementing agent. Not approved. Only the user may approve or change thresholds.

scope_note: The registry is deterministic, so exact agreement with hand-written expectations is expected. These gates check the immutability and isolation properties of ADS-054 on the reference stack; they say nothing about whether a candidate prompt is better.

outcome_agreement.measure: cases whose outcome (accepted, idempotent, rejected, visible, invisible) equals the hand-written expectation

overwrite_rejection.measure: attempts to change or imitate a released version that are rejected

released_mutations.measure: released rows whose stored content changed during the run

candidate_namespace_violations.measure: registered candidates whose version is not content-derived or looks like a release

example_text_leakage.measure: stored examples containing the request text or the feedback note

tenant_isolation.measure: tenant reads that match the visibility rule (own tenant and system only)

determinism.measure: re-registered entries that return the identical stored entry

runtime_prompt_drift.measure: samples where the latest released baseline does not render exactly the runtime prompt

protected_file_writes.measure: changes to the runtime prompt, registry contracts, goldens, thresholds, or manifest during the run

not_measured.prompt_quality: whether a candidate prompt improves answers needs evaluation against real data; that is ADS-056
